Inside the tent, one person is lying/reclining about 1–2 meters ahead, facing mostly away from the camera. Sleeping bags and loose bedding are immediately around both people and within the wearer’s reach; no cooler, water, luggage, or clearly available pillow is visible. The person and bedding occupy the space directly ahead, so offering help arranging the sleeping bag is the most appropriate, non-intrusive action.
